;International relations
*[[President of the French Republic|President]] of [[France]] [[Emmanuel Macron]], [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] of [[United Kingdom|the United Kingdom]] [[Theresa May]], [[Prime Minister of Canada|Prime Minister]] of [[Canada]] [[Justin Trudeau]] and [[President of the United States|President]] of [[United States|the United States]] [[Donald Trump]] mark the 75th Anniversary of [[Normandy landings|D-Day]] in [[Normandy]], France, paying tribute to [[Allies of World War II|Allied]] [[World War II]] veterans. *[[2018–19 Sudanese protests]]
**The [[African Union]] suspends [[Sudan]]'s membership "with immediate effect", after dozens of protesters were killed by pro-government forces in the capital [[Khartoum]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-48545543 (BBC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[Niels Högel]], post-war [[Germany]]'s [[serial killer]] with the highest known kill count, is sentenced to [[life imprisonment]] for 85 murders. [https://www.dw.com/en/german-killer-nurse-sentenced-to-life-for-murdering-patients/a-49058531 (DW)]
*American singer [[R. Kelly]] pleads not guilty to 11 additional sex-related felonies during a court hearing in [[Chicago]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/Entertainment/wireStory/latest-kelly-back-court-face-sex-charges-63530404 (ABC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Peterborough by-election]]
**The [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour Party]] holds the [[Peterborough (UK Parliament constituency)|Peterborough]] seat in the by-election, defying predictions that they would lose the seat to the [[Brexit Party]]. The seat was vacated after a [[2019 Peterborough recall petition|successful recall petition]] against its previous MP [[Fiona Onasanya]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2019/jun/07/peterborough-byelection-result-labour-sees-off-brexit-party-threat-to-hold-seat (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2019 Danish general election]]
**After the defeating of his party in the general election, [[Prime Minister of Denmark|Prime Minister]] [[Lars Løkke Rasmussen]] resigns, but will remain as acting in the office until his succession. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/denmark-election-fallout-1.5164534 (CBC)]
*[[Bolivarian diaspora]]
**In Peru, the president [[Martín Vizcarra]]'s government decides to impose humanitarian visa and passport requirements on Venezuelan immigrants who wish to enter Peru, who flee the economic, social and political crisis in their country. This happens after the expulsion of 140 Venezuelan citizens with police records and amid a growing rejection of immigrants from the Peruvian population. He said that his goal is "to ensure an orderly and safe migration we are achieving it through eliminating the bad elements.". [https://peru21.pe/peru/15-junio-venezolanos-entraran-peru-pasaporte-visa-anuncio-martin-vizcarra-expulsados-migraciones-482899 (''Perú.21'')] [https://gestion.pe/economia/mercedes-araoz-migracion-venezolana-carga-duplica-nuestra-capacidad-ofrecer-empleos-servicios-269925 (Gestión)] [https://elcomercio.pe/peru/55-limenos-acuerdo-llegada-migrantes-venezolanos-noticia-561949 (''El Comercio'')]
